integrity: Two independently structured standalone programs enumerate the relevant spaces and compare the exact transition graphs; their outputs are included and reproducible with the standard Python library. No independent scholarly audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result covers the first coexistence cutoff and the order-eleven cycle with radius-one closed-neighborhood identification. The jumping radius and diameter were established by exhaustive finite BFS; no larger-order extension is claimed. Two priority-relevant papers were available only through abstracts, so independent literature priority assessment remains outstanding.
title: The first mixed mobility of minimum identifying codes on cycles
